symbols.name: UndoHistory
symbols.summary: Gets copied history snapshots in newest-to-oldest order.

symbols.name: HandoffIdentity
symbols.summary: Gets the stable logical identity reserved by a lifecycle owner, independently of storage enablement.
symbols.remarks: Hosts assign distinct instance keys to independent views. This identity excludes runtime IDs and user context.

symbols.name: HandoffKey
symbols.summary: Gets the current context-qualified transfer key without copying the model.
symbols.remarks: The host establishes context before reading this key. Capture the destination version before deserialization.
